_comment: KAN-433 — landmark word equivalences, per language, canonical target English.
Used by the importer's translation-aware equality step (import_foursquare_tourism.translated_names_match):
each token of a normalised name is mapped through the country's table before the KAN-388 comparison,
unknown tokens stay as they are, and the pair counts as one place only within 25 m and only for
landmark/tourism rows. Keys and values are compared accent-insensitively (normalize_text on load).
`countries` maps an ISO country code to its table; add `es`, `fr`, … as their own objects.
The `en` table folds English spelling variants onto the same canonical (theatre → theater).
The pt table is the owner's list of 2026-09-18 plus what the PT Tier 1 look-list measured:
museu/museum, church, chapel, campismo/camping, centro/center, clube/club, galeria/gallery, arte/art,
estátua/statue, Jesus Cristo dos Santos dos Últimos Dias / Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, and the
saint / Our Lady forms (São, Santo, Santa, Sta., N. Sra.).
